Featured Project · 2026

20 kV multi-channel leakage-current monitoring.

Final project implemented at GI Kebonagung, combining electrical measurement, embedded acquisition, local logging, and cloud monitoring.

Undergraduate Thesis · GI Kebonagung

Implementation of a Cloud Dashboard-Based Multi-Channel Leakage Current Data Acquisition System for 20 kV Power Transformer Outgoing Cables

Designed and implemented a non-intrusive monitoring system on the bonding sheath/screen path of 20 kV outgoing cables. The system uses split-core CT sensors, 16-bit ADS1115 ADC modules, ESP32 processing, RMS and EMA data handling, RTC timestamping, SD-card logging, and HTTP/REST cloud transmission.

  • 9 active measurement channels: R1–R3, S1–S3, T1–T3.
  • Field validation against Vector Multi-Meter Densoku Techno CDM-330C.
  • Local CSV logging supports historical analysis when cloud access is unavailable.
  • Designed as an early condition-monitoring tool based on trends, not as a standalone insulation diagnosis.
